TAPES.s: A corrupted Beginner's Bible tape. Satan, posing as Gabriel, tells shepherds he is their "true savior." An unknown voice pleads from a sand tomb.
TAPES.n: The video that started the series. It began as a high-school writing project.

TAPES.s: Four tapes: an Alternate-avoidance PSA, the evidence reel on Mark Heathcliff's death, a 911 training video and a child-reaction test.
TAPES.n: Restored and re-released April 4, 2023 at 17:29. The runtime shown is the original.

TAPES.s: A PSA on unsupervised children and television. A mother finds her missing child, is taunted by a smiling face on the screen, and dies. Police dismiss the Alternate explanation.
TAPES.n: The face in this video returns in Vol. 2.

TAPES.s: Mark Heathcliff was stalked by Alternates for weeks. Investigator Thatcher Davis calls it paranoia. A Beginner's Bible tape retells Noah's Ark, with Satan promising an Alternate a "last message" on the Ark.
TAPES.n: First Beginner's Bible retelling after overthrone.

TAPES.s: Adam Murray and Jonah Marshall investigate a "ghost cat." Adam falls asleep, is whispered to by an Alternate, and enters a locked room with an analog TV showing the face from intruder alert. Jonah drives off and is presumed killed.
TAPES.n: Introduces the Bythorne Paranormal Society pair.

TAPES.s: Lynn calls Jude about their crying son. Reels cover Mark's death (blamed on an Alternate of Cesar Torres) and the Stanley puppet's "imaginary friend" broadcast. Ruth Weaver is killed and Thatcher is attacked.
TAPES.n: The Murray house incident. Adam is the crying child.

TAPES.s: Thatcher records a tape for Ruth, voicing his fears and vowing to kill the Alternate impersonating him.
TAPES.n: Written by Thorne Baker, who also plays Thatcher.

TAPES.s: County population falls from 15,000 (1992) to about 1,000 (2009). A USDTP propaganda tape describes three assimilation types: Flawed, Complete and Overdriven.
TAPES.n: The clearest look at what the Alternates have done to the county.

TAPES.s: A retelling of Genesis. In 2009, Evelin finds the Stress Assessment tape. Adam agrees to make a memorial video for Jonah. Gabriel, revealed as O'Brien, kills Dave Lee. Evelin meets an Alternate at the empty police station. The Intruder tells Adam he is an Alternate.
TAPES.n: The longest tape. Its live-action green-screen segments drew criticism; Kister says the artificial look is deliberate.

TAPES.t: The Beginner's Bible "The Story of Easter" Clips circa 1995
TAPES.s: From the affiliated GENESIS APOCRYPHON channel. Guards and nuns find "Gabriel" in a cave, implying Jesus is in the tomb.
TAPES.n: The series keeps rewriting Bible stories with Gabriel in the wrong place.

TAPES.s: Dave's autopsy shows missing eyes. Gabriel tells Thatcher to "go and see." Thatcher finds Adam in agony, begging to be killed.
A MandelaTech going-out-of-business ad. Evelin and Sarah hack security cameras and find footage of Thatcher and Adam. Adam says God told him he is "paying the price" for Jonah's death.
TAPES.n: Adam's guilt over Jonah becomes explicit.

TAPES.s: From GENESIS APOCRYPHON. Adam's drawings of Gabriel and the Intruder. Ends with "answers lie beneath."
A 2015 Vine compilation that cuts to a dark room where a doorknob begins to turn.
TAPES.n: First clear step into the digital era.

TAPES.s: In 1992, Jude Murray tries to escape through "Midwestern Relocation Services" and is attacked by the Alternate N. A stop-motion shepherd story is likely linked to overthrone. Jude ends paralyzed.
A looping "get ready with me" TikTok that corrupts with each repeat.
Dave Lee tests VHS generational loss. The copies deteriorate before a likely Alternate attack.
TAPES.n: Dave Lee appears here after his death in Vol. 4, so this may be earlier footage.

TAPES.s: Two forum users discuss family outings in Southern Wisconsin. One turns hostile and tries to cause M.A.D. in the other.
Julie, Amanda and Noah discuss Addison's suicide video from Cognitohazard. Adam, in Alternate form, leads Noah and Amanda to a mirror-filled house in the woods. The camcorder dies as Noah flees.
TAPES.n: The most recent main volume as of October 2026.

CASES.p: Former Mandela County PD lieutenant. He first treats Mark's case as paranoia, then spends years seeking revenge on the Alternates.
Bythorne Paranormal Society member, abducted as a child, searching for his mother. The Intruder tells him he is an Alternate.
CASES.st: Status: appears as an Alternate in Vol. 6

CASES.p: Founded the Bythorne Paranormal Society to find out what happened to her brother Mark.
Adam's ex-girlfriend. She investigates his changed behavior and finds the Stress Assessment tape.
Teenager stalked by Alternates, then lured into a trap by a copy of his friend Cesar Torres. His death starts the main storyline.
Adam's parents. The Alternates destroy them both. Jude ends paralyzed after an attack by N.
Thatcher's fellow officer. Killed by the Murray House Alternate.
Bythorne Paranormal Society member. He drives off after Adam enters the locked room and is presumed killed.
MandelaTECH manager. Gabriel kills him in Vol. 4; his autopsy later shows missing eyes.

QS.n: Alex Kister started it on YouTube in 2021, at 17.

QS.q: When was the first video, overthrone, released?
QS.n: June 9, 2021. Vol. 1 followed two months later.

QS.q: What happens to Mandela County's population between 1992 and 2009?
QS.n: That's the figure given on the interlude tape.

QS.q: Which is NOT one of the three assimilation types named on the USDTP tape?
QS.n: The three are Flawed, Complete and Overdriven.

QS.q: Which volume is a retelling of Genesis?
QS.n: Vol. 4 is also the longest tape at 40:53.

QS.q: In Vol. 4, who is Gabriel revealed to be?
QS.n: Gabriel, as O'Brien, then kills Dave Lee.

QS.q: What is the Intruder, according to Wikipedia's summary?
o: Not an Alternate; described as an ally
QS.n: It is tied to TV and the abduction of over 3,000 children.
